title: Grey-block to video (HyperFlow H3 Flash)
description: Turn a grey-block clip and character references into a cinematic shot with HyperFlow H3 Flash on this computer.

controls.label: Direction
controls.default:
Use the supplied video as previsualisation, not a literal blueprint. The simple shapes and placeholder set represent a possible action and spatial layout, not final objects, materials, architecture, proportions or an instruction to reproduce the set exactly.
Create a coherent, photoreal cinematic scene that follows the user's direction and the supplied character and other references. Interpret placeholder figures as characters with believable human scale, body language and purposeful interaction. Build a plausible environment appropriate to the requested story, and adapt or replace placeholder structures and props where needed. Do not invent unrelated furniture or activities.
Use the source video as a guide to the main action, timing and camera movement where compatible with the requested scene; allow framing, spatial relationships, scale and motion to adapt naturally. Preserve any specific elements or exact movements explicitly requested by the user. Keep characters, wardrobe and important props consistent across the shot.
Match lighting, textures, perspective and shadows throughout. Sound should fit the action and the selected audio policy.

evidence: 2026-11-07: The existing Grey-block to video graph retains its video, character and optional picture bindings. The HyperFlow H3 Flash Ref2VA GGUF uses Euler and the six-step HyperFlow schedule.

2026-11-07: A local rooftop grey-block test with a single character reference produced 56 frames at 928 × 512 with generated audio. The result visibly followed the camera movement and used the mascot and rooftop layout.

licenses.software: Adapted from Comfy Org's MiniMax H3 Video Restyling graph. Requires ComfyUI core (GPL-3.0) and the reviewed HyperFlow loader.
